name: GetSpecialFolderPath(kind, cRZString *out, bool ensure) (cdecl; al)
notes: Lane LY (F4). Ownerless free helper of the file system. Kinds 0 Windows directory (the image's optional GetWindowsDirectoryW pointer 0x10cb628, else GetWindowsDirectoryA; >= 0x105 fails), 1 recycle bin / 2 fonts (SHGetFolderPathW pointer 0x10cb62c with fallback id 0; without it "C:\\recycled\\" and the Windows directory's "Fonts\\"), 3 the executable's directory (GetModulePath, GetModuleDirectory), 4..13 five user / all-users CSIDL pairs, each falling back to the other (SHGetFolderPathW, else SHGetSpecialFolderLocation + SHGetPathFromIDListA, the list freed with SHGetMalloc's allocator); others false. A '\\' is appended unless the text ends in a separator; with ensure the result is EnsureDirectory's (0x1c5031). Test SpecialFolders_GetSpecialFolderPath: 6528 cases (17 kinds incl. -1, 14, 0x7fffffff; each wide pointer present / null; ensure 0, 1, 0x80, 0x100; 24 answer scripts): imports through impfx, the wide pointers and our / the image's callees (ConvertBytesToString, GetModulePath, GetModuleDirectory, DirectoryExists, CreateDirectories) stood in on both sides; compared al, the out text and the log. Hooked. Mutants (build/ly-mut-folders.json): 10 of 11 killed (CSIDL pair, buffer bound, empty-text checks, the list not freed, recycle-bin fallback id, module directory dropped, separator check, ensure result ignored); the survivor drops the Fonts text's backslash, equivalent because the trailing-separator step appends it.

name: EnsureDirectory(cRZString *path) (cdecl: DirectoryExists, else CreateDirectories; al)
notes: Lane LY (F4). True (al 1, the upper bytes DirectoryExists' leftovers) when the directory exists, else CreateDirectories' result (a tail jump). Test SpecialFolders_EnsureDirectory: 64 scripts, both callees stood in on both sides with answers that carry upper bits; compared al, the path and the log. Hooked; our callers (cTSAppFW, cTSCustomContentSupport, cTSNeighborhoodManager, cTSObjectFolder, cTSPersistSystem) call ours. Mutants: true returned as 2 killed.
